preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 50000.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= k <= n <= 100000 for n, k in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of nodes n is between 2 and 100000, and k is between 2 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 1000000000 for test_case in test_cases for a_i in test_case['a'])
preconditions.description: For each test case, each node value a_i is between 1 and 1000000000.

preconditions.expression: all(len(test_case['edges']) == n - 1 for test_case in test_cases for n in [test_case['n']])
preconditions.description: Each test case has exactly n-1 edges.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= u_i <= n and 1 <= v_i <= n and u_i != v_i for u_i, v_i in test_case['edges']) for test_case in test_cases for n in [test_case['n']])
preconditions.description: For each test case, each edge connects two distinct nodes within the range 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout[i] in ['YES', 'NO', 'yes', 'no'] for i in range(len(test_cases)))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either 'YES' or 'NO' (case-insensitive).

postconditions.expression: all((stdout[i] == 'YES' or stdout[i] == 'yes') == can_achieve_condition(test_cases[i]) for i in range(len(test_cases)))
postconditions.description: The output is 'YES' if and only if it is possible to delete at least 1 but at most k-1 edges to make the bitwise XOR of all connected components the same.
